title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — Rule 17, requisitionists’ EGM

content.publisher: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), e-book statutory text reproduction
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014, rule 17; includes the 2016 substitution of “on any day except national holiday” for “on working day” in rule 17(2) Explanation
content.note: ICSI’s reproduction provides a useful view of Rule 17, but is not itself Gazette-primary. The linked official Gazette notification G.S.R. 908(E), 23 September 2016, confirms the specific substitution in the Explanation to rule 17(2): “on any day except national holiday” replaced “on working day”. The full current consolidated Rule 17 text, all sub-rules and subsequent amendments remain to be reconciled against official notifications; this source record remains under review.
